title: NSWP world manifest (/.well-known/nswp.json)
description: Served over https with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *, at most 64 KB, fetched without following redirects. Unknown fields are ignored. See spec §7.

items.description: Letters, digits, ., _ and - (1-128 chars); clients skip others with a warning.

endpoint.description: Must be wss://; clients ignore other values with a warning.

airlock.description: Must be https://; clients ignore other values with a warning.

access.description: The listings a paid world is entered by: a list of listings' coordinates (30078:<pubkey>:<name>), each sold by a key this file names as a publisher of this world, at most 8. Left out, the world is free. Clients ignore anything else with a warning.

keepers.description: A list of 64 lowercase hex keys; clients skip anything else with a warning. Meaning: Whose allow and block lists count for this world, at most 4 (more are ignored with a warning). Left out, the world's publishers; but a world that writes neither this nor a word that needs a list reads no list.

named_only.description: true: in this world's rooms a visitor's kit shows and hears only people whose pass checks out. Only exactly true turns it on; clients ignore other values with a warning.

items.description: wss:// relay URLs; clients skip others with a warning.

kit.description: The version of the NSWP kit the site was built with. The site's own word: a client may tell a visitor that a world's controls are older than its own, and nothing else is decided by it.
